confidence_notes: Medium overall. Meal anchors are the strongest, drawn from Antofagasta-specific aggregated cost-of-living listings of mixed dates (one from Dec 2024, others from 2026). Beer and coffee rest on dated or thin data plus a Santiago restaurant-beer benchmark; the Numbeo Antofagasta draft-beer figure looked too low for restaurant service and was discounted. No Antofagasta cocktail or wine-by-the-glass price was found, so cocktail is set at about 2x the beer anchor and wine_glass at about 1.3x, cross-checked against Chilean pisco sour menus of unconfirmed location. All four accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or listing checks were run, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Antofagasta-specific aggregated listings were used directly for meal anchors. Santiago served as the comparable benchmark for restaurant beer and bar drink levels. Cocktail and wine-glass anchors are derived from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors reflect general Chilean hostel and hotel norms for a comparable mid-sized port and mining city.
